messages:
jessica-support: Heads-up — multiple EU customers reporting very high p99 API latency (3–6s) since ~03:08 UTC. Ticket #C-7621. Symptoms: requests stalling on TLS handshake or long DNS resolution. Sample curl timings from customer below. Anyone oncall?

sam-oncall: I'm on. Which POP/region are they hitting? Any correlation to deploys?

mike-customer-success: Customers in DE/FR/IE. Example curl from customer:
```
$ curl -w "time_connect:%{time_connect} time_appconnect:%{time_appconnect} time_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null -s https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
time_connect:0.050 time_appconnect:1.892 time_total:3.412
```
One customer sees TLS handshake ~1.9s.

sam-oncall: thanks. @natalie-net can you run probes/traceroute from our EU probes to the clients' egress?

natalie-net: Running traceroutes and dig against client's IP. Early findings:
```
$ traceroute -n 85.214.132.11
1 10.0.0.1
2 52.95.0.1
3 52.95.12.45
4 87.246.64.129  120 ms  118 ms  119 ms
5 80.81.192.1    120 ms  121 ms  118 ms
6 ... -> long AS path with extra hop via FR transit (adds ~100ms)
```
And dig showing EDNS client subnet being used by our DNS provider leading to different anycast mapping:
```
$ dig +short @8.8.8.8 api.redwood.com
13.225.78.10
```
Our internal probes to that IP show egress to a POP that adds an extra cross-country hop.

kevin-sre: I grabbed tcpdump at the edge and a few TLS handshakes show retransmits and delayed ServerHello:
```
14:03:10.123 IP client -> edge: SYN
14:03:10.125 IP edge -> client: SYN,ACK
14:03:11.320 IP client -> edge: ACK  (1.2s gap)
14:03:11.321 TLS ClientHello
14:03:13.200 TLS ServerHello  (1.9s appconnect)
```
Also seen increased cwnd drops and retransmits during the period.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: main-edge-2026-03-17T02:45Z by @deploy-team (no config changes to routing).

natalie-net: hypothesis: our DNS provider recently started honoring EDNS-client-subnet more aggressively; some clients are now steered to a different EU POP (edge-pop-eu-2) which currently has a flaky upstream transit route causing AS-path elongation and packet loss -> longer handshake tails. I can see higher tcp retransmits out of that pop.

sam-oncall: good call. Mitigations to try (short-term):
- revert GSLB weight shift to send affected geos to stable POP (eu-west1)
- reduce DNS TTL for api.redwood.com to 30s and flush resolver cache if possible
- add temporary ip-hint-based local steering for these customers (pin their IP prefixes to eu-west1)
- if needed, fail closed to next-closest region for affected customers
I'll coordinate rollback.

kevin-sre: I'll prepare a one-hour route pin via traffic-engineer job and watch retransmit rate. Also enable packet-capture for 10 minutes on edge-pop-eu-2 to gather traces.

natalie-net: Started GSLB weight rollback now (in 2m). Also opened ticket with DNS provider asking to disable EDNS-client-subnet for our zone while we triage.

mike-customer-success: Please share ETA to customers. They're asking for a rollback or workaround.

sam-oncall: ETA 15–20m for rollback to finish and monitoring to stabilize. If p99 doesn't improve, we'll move clients to eu-west1 and open support SLA credit. @jessica-support can you tell customers we'll update in 20m?

jessica-support: Yes — telling customers we expect improvement within 30m, will follow up with ticket.

kevin-sre: After rollback: packet loss dropped from 3.2% -> 0.4% on eu-pop-eu-2, and TLS appconnect median moved 1.9s -> 0.18s for sampled flows. Monitoring dashboards show p99 for EU APIs back to normal. Leaving capture running for 10m to confirm.

natalie-net: DNS provider responded: EDNS-client-subnet was turned on during a global rollout on March 16. They will roll back for our zone temporarily. Recommend we add a guardrail to our DNS config to avoid aggressive ECS mapping.

sam-oncall: Postmortem actions:
- blocklist/guard EDNS-client-subnet settings with provider
- add automatic alert on cross-pop retransmit rate >1%
- implement IP-hint steering runbook for fast mitigation
Assigning: @natalie-net (DNS config + provider), @kevin-sre (monitoring + packet capture), @sam-oncall (runbook + routing pin).

jessica-support: Thanks team — update ticket and I'll send customers summary.
